about: I'm a Full Stack Engineer specializing in React and Next.js. I build responsive, accessible interfaces and reliable backend services, focusing on performance, maintainability, and developer experience.
Highlights: Built 15+ reusable UI components; implemented SSR and SEO optimizations; integrated PostgreSQL-backed APIs.
Tech: React, Next.js, Tailwind CSS, Node.js, Express, PostgreSQL, Git

experiences.title: JS Full Stack Engineer
experiences.description:
Developed and maintained production-grade applications using React.js and Next.js across multiple client engagements.
Built and enhanced 15+ reusable UI components with Tailwind CSS, accelerating feature delivery and ensuring cross-browser compatibility.
Integrated REST APIs for real-time data rendering and worked with backend teams to streamline application workflows.
Reviewed code and supported junior developers with debugging, improving team delivery quality.

experiences.title: Full Stack Developer Intern
experiences.description:
Tech Stack: React.js, Next.js, Node.js, Express.js, PostgreSQL, Tailwind CSS.
Built reusable frontend components and worked on backend API development and database operations using Node.js, Express.js, and PostgreSQL.
Participated in Agile sprints including bug fixing, code reviews, and source control using Git, GitLab, and AWS CodeCommit.

education.description: Specialized in Software Engineering and Web Technologies.

education.degree: Bachelor of Physical Science with Computer Science
education.description: Focused on programming fundamentals, data structures, and algorithms.

projects.title: Tata Play Hotel Management System
projects.description:
Led UI improvements across multiple modules of an enterprise hotel management platform, enhancing usability and visual consistency.
Implemented a concurrent login system supporting distinct Admin and Super Admin roles with session isolation and access control.
Developed end-to-end UI pages and handled complex API integrations for dynamic content rendering across user workflows.

projects.title: Tata Play Live TV App
projects.description:
Implemented SEO across the entire platform including structured URL design, dynamic meta tags, and semantic markup to improve discoverability.
Resolved 15+ UI bugs and improved web accessibility compliance by applying WCAG 2.1 standards across key user journeys.
Optimized page rendering and component structure, contributing to faster load times and a smoother viewing experience for end users.

projects.title: MedCare Connect — Doctor Appointment Platform
projects.description:
Developed a full stack doctor appointment platform enabling doctor discovery, appointment booking, and availability management.
Implemented SSR using Next.js to improve SEO performance and initial page load speed.
Built backend APIs using Node.js, Express.js, and PostgreSQL for appointment and user management workflows.

projects.title: SmartCalc
projects.description: A multifunctional digital tool that performs standard arithmetic calculations and includes features for BMI calculation and currency conversion. The app uses an API for real-time currency exchange rates.

projects.title: Dictionary app
projects.description: A user-friendly web application that provides quick access to word definitions, synonyms, antonyms, and pronunciations. Key features include voice pronunciation.
